QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Halflinger Hostilities
QuestInfo.0: Crow appeared in Leafre, but why?
QuestInfo.1: Shut down the Kentaurus uprising and save the Halflingers in Crow's stead.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Kentaurus threat. The Halflingers should be able to live in peace now.

0.0: I should've known you'd be hanging out with these fuzzballs. I'm guessing you've heard about the grudge those Kentauruses hold against the Halflingers. Lucky for me, you owe me one for dragging your useless hide out of that explosion. So you get to help them out.

yes.0: I knew you'd see it my way. We need to show these fuzzballs that they don't need to be scared by a bunch of punk Kentauruses. I'm sick of listening to them whimpering all day. Oh, and since you owe me so much, why don't you go down to #m240020200# and take care of the Mystic Gate over there too?

no.0: Are you really going to refuse the man that saved your life?

1.0: I'm pretty sure I still saw some Kentauruses hanging out. Are you sure you got them all?

mob.0: Take out the Red, Black, and Blue Kentauruses that keep attacking the Halflingers. Taking down 50 of them should teach them a lesson and just MIGHT show the Halflingers that they don't have to keep getting bullied.
